Stirling establishes the exact exponential base. The standalone finite checker replays and corroborates the nonstandard combinatorial identities for selected dimensions, but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The antipodal quotient cube is a natural translation-invariant graph-metric family. Its critical exponent characterizes Hilbert snowflake embeddability, with ordinary Boolean cubes positive at exponent one while folded quotients exhibit a dimension-dependent critical scale. An exact exponential base over an infinite subsequence is mathematically structural despite not resolving a polynomial factor or each individual critical value.
